=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:176-185 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A `waiting` webhook action pops the job from `queued`/`webhook_seen` without recording it in `started`, so the job becomes invisible to the scaler and no droplet or `queued_without_supply` alert is produced.
  WHY: The job can wait for a runner that never comes with no alert; `_full_scan` only admits status "queued". Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax) vs NIT (glm). Reviewer anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered this and rejected it, because `waiting` is an environment or deployment gate, not a runner queue.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:497-519 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The ambiguous-create branch consumes a capacity slot and bumps `booting[repo]` but does not recompute or decrement `want`, so a spurious or misleading `cap_reached` log and alert can fire.
  WHY: The alert is false or misleading in a pass where the create timed out, and the next pass corrects it.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:497-520 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `booting[repo] += 1` after an ambiguous create suppresses the `queued_without_supply` alert for the repository's other queued jobs that have no supply.
  WHY: A timed-out create can mask a real no-supply condition for up to 15 minutes (the register timeout).
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:391-393 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `due[:PENDING_RERUNS_PER_PASS]` slices in insertion order, so permanently stuck re-runs can occupy the slots and block other pending re-runs.
  WHY: Stuck jobs stay at the head of `pending_reruns` and are retried first each pass. Reviewers anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said this is at most a fairness nit, because the 300 s retry spacing bounds the delay. Reviewer anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it outright.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:`_create_for_demand` ambiguous-create branch | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: After an ambiguous create, `want` is not recomputed, so the pass can log `skipped reason=cap_reached` and send the `cap_reached` alert. Separately, `booting[repo] += 1` suppresses `queued_without_supply` for the repository's other unsupplied queued jobs.
  WHY: The effect is one possibly misleading alert or log line, or one suppressed alert. The next pass corrects it, and the cap alert is arguably accurate.
- TASK_GAP: Checklist item 5 of `/seed-repo` should tell the user how to resume onboarding when the scaler is in dry run.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md`, checklist item 5
  Evidence of absence: Item 5 in both copies has no dry-run or resume wording. The gating behaviour already exists in step 6(c) part 2 and the Config status line.
  severity=low | confidence=4
- Rejected after checking: the `waiting` action losing demand, and `due[:PENDING_RERUNS_PER_PASS]` starvation.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:176-178 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `waiting` webhook action removes the job from `queued` demand and does not record it in `started`, so the job becomes invisible to the scaler.
  WHY: No droplet is created and the `queued_without_supply` alert will not fire.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:504-519 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: An ambiguous droplet creation bumps `booting[repo]` but does not recompute `want`, so the alert at line 531 can fire when capacity is reached.
  WHY: The `cap_reached` alert uses the original `want` and `capacity`, which gives the operator a false alert.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:392-393 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `pending_reruns` processing slices the first `PENDING_RERUNS_PER_PASS` entries in insertion order, so permanently stuck re-runs can block others.
  WHY: Stuck jobs stay at the head of the dict and are retried first on every pass.
- TASK_GAP: Checklist item 5 in `seed-repo.md` should say step 2 stops when the started line shows dry_run=true and how to resume.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md`, checklist item 5
  Evidence of absence: Item 5 does not mention the dry_run=true stop or the resume path. The template-copy change was reverted last iteration.
  severity=high | confidence=5
- Hardening: in `_process_pending_reruns`, sort `due` by `self.rerun_last_try.get(key, 0)` (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:176-180, 442, 484-486, 517-519 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The webhook path and the full-scan path disagree on which job states count as demand. A `waiting` action pops the job from `queued` and excludes it from `started`, and `_full_scan` only admits status "queued", so a `waiting` job is never re-added.
  WHY: The job is invisible to the scaler, so no droplet is created and no `queued_without_supply` alert fires. The job waits until the workflow timeout with no page.
- TASK_GAP: Checklist item 5 must say that step 2 stops when the `started` line shows `dry_run=true`, and how to resume.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md`, checklist item 5 (line 58)
  Evidence of absence: Both copies still read the old item 5 with no dry-run stop and no resume clause. `app.yaml` ships `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN=true`. The last run diff does not touch either copy.
  severity=low | confidence=5
- Hardening (reconcile.py:391-392): `due[:PENDING_RERUNS_PER_PASS]` is a fairness nit, not a hang. Fix: sort `due` by `rerun_last_try` ascending. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Hardening (reconcile.py:498-516): the ambiguous-create branch does not decrement `want`, so `cap_reached` can fire although the job is covered. Fix: decrement `want` alongside `capacity`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:497-506, 517-519 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: An ambiguous create is counted as one booting droplet, which suppresses the repository's `queued_without_supply` alert even when other queued jobs remain uncovered.
  WHY: The alert condition only checks `booting[repo] == 0`, so the remaining jobs without supply are not alerted. If the request created no droplet, none of the jobs has supply.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:176-185 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A `waiting` webhook action pops the job from `queued` and `webhook_seen` without recording it in `started`, so demand is dropped. The job is only recovered by the next full scan, at most every 600 s by default.
  WHY: A job queued behind a concurrency group waits up to 10 minutes with no droplet and no alert, and `server.py` wakes the loop with nothing to act on.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:504-508, 517-520 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `booting[repo] += 1` for an ambiguous create suppresses the `queued_without_supply` alert whenever at least one ambiguous create happened, even with other jobs uncovered.
  WHY: A transport-failed create can mask a real no-supply condition for up to 15 minutes.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:501-514 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ambiguous-create branch consumes a capacity slot and bumps `booting[repo]` but never decrements `want`. With `max_droplets=1` and one timed-out create, `cap_reached` is logged and alerted although the only job is covered.
  WHY: The operator gets a spurious cap-reached page and a log line that contradicts the same pass's booting count.
- TASK_GAP: The onboarding flow must never reach `PIPELINE_RUNS_ON=do-runner` while the scaler is in dry run, and a pending onboarding must be resumable (status `pending scaler dry run`).
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md`, checklist item 5 (line 58 in both copies)
  Evidence of absence: Item 5 has no dry-run stop or resume guidance, and the last run diff did not touch either copy. A session resuming from item 5 alone could set `PIPELINE_RUNS_ON=do-runner` while `RUNNER_SCALER_DRY_RUN=true`.
  severity=high | confidence=4
- Hardening: in the ambiguous branch, decrement `want` next to `booting[repo] += 1`, or guard the cap branch with `want > booting[repo]` (1-2 lines).
- Hardening: in `_process_pending_reruns`, sort `due` by `self.rerun_last_try.get(key, 0.0)` (about 1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
